scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('npx puppeteer browsers install chrome', { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR: process.env.PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR || '/opt/render/.cache/puppeteer' } }); } catch(e) { console.warn('Chrome install failed, will rely on system chrome or PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH'); }"
